terms.definition: Orders food or drink in Spain, like “Can I get…?” It sounds friendly, not rude.
terms.example: ¿Me pone un café con leche, por favor? — A white coffee, please.
terms.anti_example: Not “¿Puedo tener un café?”: that copies English word for word. Say “¿Me pone un café?”

terms.definition: Says the food in front of you tastes good: “it's delicious”.
terms.example: Mmm, la paella está muy rica. — The paella is really good.
terms.anti_example: Not “la paella es rica”: with ser, rico usually means rich, as in “mi tío es rico”.

terms.definition: Checks if something is possible or allowed here. Put the action right after puede.
terms.example: ¿Se puede pagar con tarjeta? — Can I pay by card?
terms.discussion: Handy for house rules too: “¿Se puede fumar en la terraza?” The answer is “sí, se puede” or “no, no se puede”.
